newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue chips end up in thin trade, small caps off.
newsitem.headline: KL blue chips end up in thin trade, small caps off.

text.p: Malaysian blue-chip stocks closed higher in quiet trading, but small-cap issues ended sharply lower after gains in previous weeks.
The Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stocks ended up 5.71 points to 1,223.78, while the small-cap Second Board index closed down 10.84 to 564.22.

"There have been two buy programs active in the market today, one from the U.S. and one European," said an institutional dealer at a local bank-backed brokerage. "But they have been concentrating exclusively on blue-chip stocks," he added.
